collection.title: BMW 3 Series Coupe 1992 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 3 Series Coupe 1992 to 1999 requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. The choice of rear screen wipers for this 3 Series Coupe which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
